codes.title: Unknown property
codes.cause: The document contains a property that its schema does not define. Only properties prefixed with `x-` may be added freely; they are preserved and ignored by the compiler (SCH-004).
codes.fix: Remove the property, correct its spelling, or prefix it with `x-` to keep it as an extension.

codes.title: Missing required property
codes.cause: A property that the schema requires is absent.
codes.fix: Add the property with a valid value.

codes.title: Wrong JSON type
codes.cause: A value has a different JSON type from the one the schema allows, for example a number where a string is expected.
codes.fix: Change the value to the expected type.

codes.title: Value not allowed
codes.cause: The value is not one of the values the schema allows.
codes.fix: Use one of the allowed values listed in the message.

codes.title: Invalid format
codes.cause: A string does not have the required format, such as a UUIDv7 identifier, a lower-kebab key, a BCP 47 locale or a semantic version.
codes.fix: Correct the string to the documented format.

codes.title: Value out of range
codes.cause: A number, a string length or an item count is outside the bounds the schema allows.
codes.fix: Choose a value within the bounds given in the message.

codes.title: Invalid structure
codes.cause: The value matches none of the forms the schema allows, for example a prop value that is neither a literal nor exactly one of `$expr`, `$token`, `$t` or `$asset` (SCH-011).
codes.fix: Restructure the value into one of the allowed forms.

codes.title: Invalid JSON
codes.cause: The file is not well-formed JSON: a syntax error, a duplicate key in one object, invalid UTF-8 or an unpaired surrogate escape.
codes.fix: Fix the file at the reported position; each key may appear only once per object.

codes.title: Unsupported schema version
codes.cause: The document's `schemaVersion` is not a released version, or is newer than this compiler understands (SCH-000).
codes.fix: Upgrade the Plux CLI or server, or correct `schemaVersion`.

codes.title: Schema migration failed
codes.cause: The document could not be migrated from its `schemaVersion` to the current version (SCH-043).
codes.fix: Report the document to the Plux maintainers: migrations must accept every valid document of a released version.

codes.title: Duplicate identifier
codes.cause: Two entities in the project share an identifier. Identifiers are unique and immutable, and every reference uses them (SCH-002).
codes.fix: Give the copied entity a fresh UUIDv7. Inserting a template assigns fresh identifiers automatically (SCH-031).

codes.title: Invalid project layout
codes.cause: A file is not where the project layout expects a document of its kind, its name does not match its key, or a required file is missing (SCH-006).
codes.fix: Move or rename the file as described in the document-model reference.

codes.title: Request too large
codes.cause: The request body, or a value inside it, is larger than the limit the installation allows. Limits bound every input so that one caller cannot exhaust the server (SEC-104).
codes.fix: Send less in one call, or ask an administrator to raise the limit for this installation.

codes.title: The document changed
codes.cause: The document has been written since the revision this call is based on, so applying the change would overwrite that work (SRV-030).
codes.fix: Read the document again, reapply the change to the current revision, and send it.

codes.title: Idempotency key reused
codes.cause: The idempotency key was used before with a different request. A key identifies one request, so that a retry returns the original result rather than acting twice (SRV-005).
codes.fix: Use a new idempotency key for a different request, or repeat the original request unchanged.

codes.title: Invalid page token
codes.cause: The page token is not one this server issued, or it belongs to a different filter or ordering. Tokens are integrity-protected and bound to the query they continue (SRV-004).
codes.fix: Start the list again without a page token.

codes.title: Duplicate key
codes.cause: Two entities with the same parent share a key. Keys are unique within their parent (SCH-002).
codes.fix: Rename one of them.

codes.title: Unresolved reference
codes.cause: A reference names an identifier that does not exist in the project: a page, component, action graph, translation key, design token, asset, state entry, data source, collection, function or native route.
codes.fix: Correct the identifier, or create the entity it refers to.

codes.title: Duplicate route name
codes.cause: Two pages or native routes use the same route name. Route names are unique across the whole app, because callers address screens by route name only (SCH-025).
codes.fix: Rename one of the routes.

codes.title: Unknown widget type
codes.cause: A node's `type` is neither a registered widget (WGT-001) nor a native slot declared in the native catalogue.
codes.fix: Use a widget from the catalogue, or expose the host widget as a native slot.

codes.title: Unknown prop
codes.cause: A node sets a prop that its widget's descriptor does not declare.
codes.fix: Remove the prop or correct its name; the widget reference lists every supported prop.

codes.title: Prop type mismatch
codes.cause: A prop's literal or binding does not have the type its descriptor declares.
codes.fix: Provide a value of the declared type, or convert the binding explicitly.

codes.title: Missing required prop
codes.cause: The widget's descriptor marks a prop as required and the node does not set it.
codes.fix: Set the prop.

codes.title: Unknown event
codes.cause: A node handles an event that its widget does not emit.
codes.fix: Remove the handler or correct the event name.

codes.title: Invalid children
codes.cause: The node has `children` although its widget takes named slots or no children, or it has more or fewer children than the widget allows.
codes.fix: Use the widget's slots, or adjust the number of children.

codes.title: Unknown slot
codes.cause: A node fills a slot that its widget does not declare.
codes.fix: Use one of the widget's declared slots.

codes.title: Missing required slot
codes.cause: The widget's descriptor requires a slot that the node does not fill.
codes.fix: Fill the slot.

codes.title: Unknown action
codes.cause: An action-graph step uses an action that is neither built in (spec Appendix D) nor a custom action declared in the native catalogue.
codes.fix: Use a catalogued action, or register the custom action in the host app.

codes.title: Invalid action graph
codes.cause: An action graph has a cycle, an edge to a missing step, an unreachable step or no entry step (ACT-001).
codes.fix: Make the graph acyclic, starting at its first step, with every edge naming an existing step.

codes.title: Component version not found
codes.cause: An instance references a version of a component that the project does not contain (SCH-030).
codes.fix: Reference the component's current version.

codes.title: Unknown type
codes.cause: A type expression names a type that is neither built in (SCH-010) nor declared in the app or plugin.
codes.fix: Declare the named type, or correct its name.

codes.title: Invalid type expression
codes.cause: A type expression is not well formed, for example `list<` without a closing bracket.
codes.fix: Write the type as the type grammar describes, e.g. `list<string>`, `map<string,int>` or `decimal?`.

codes.title: Value does not match its declared type
codes.cause: A default value, mock value or parameter value does not have its declared type.
codes.fix: Change the value, or the declared type.

codes.title: Missing design-time mock
codes.cause: A data source or page parameter has no design-time mock, so Studio and tests cannot render the page without a live backend (SCH-024).
codes.fix: Add a mock value of the declared type.

codes.title: Newer than the minimum runtime
codes.cause: A node uses a widget, prop, event or slot introduced after the app's `minRuntimeVersion`, and the app does not allow raising the required features (WGT-004).
codes.fix: Raise `minRuntimeVersion`, avoid the newer member, or allow raising required features in the app document.

codes.title: Required features raised
codes.cause: The release uses members newer than the app's `minRuntimeVersion`, so the compiler added required features; devices with older runtimes keep their last compatible release (WGT-004).
codes.fix: Check how many installed devices are affected before releasing.

codes.title: Prop constraint violated
codes.cause: A literal prop value violates a constraint in its descriptor, such as a minimum, a maximum or a pattern.
codes.fix: Choose a value that meets the constraint given in the message.

codes.title: Deprecated widget or prop
codes.cause: The node uses a widget, prop, event or slot that its descriptor marks as deprecated.
codes.fix: Replace it as the deprecation note describes.

codes.title: Unknown icon
codes.cause: An icon names a glyph its set does not have, or computes its name, so the server cannot deliver its glyph in the release's icon font (THM-005).
codes.fix: Use a name from the set's catalogue (docs/reference/icons.md), written literally.

codes.title: Custom action named like a built-in action
codes.cause: The native catalogue declares a custom action with the name of a built-in action (spec Appendix D). A step of that name always runs the built-in action, so the host's action would be reachable only through callNative (ACT-060).
codes.fix: Rename the custom action in the host app, for example with a prefix of its own, and run plux native scan again.

codes.title: Flows call each other in a cycle
codes.cause: A callFlow step calls a flow that, through its own callFlow steps, calls the graph back. Action graphs are acyclic across flows too, so a run cannot recurse (ACT-001, ACT-061).
codes.fix: Break the cycle: move the shared steps into a flow that calls neither graph.

codes.title: Flow private to its plugin
codes.cause: A callFlow step names a flow of another plugin as <plugin>/<flow>, and that flow is not exported. Only exported flows are callable across plugins (ACT-061).
codes.fix: Set exported on the flow in its plugin, or call a flow of the step's own plugin by its key.

codes.title: Invalid trigger
codes.cause: A trigger names something its owner cannot see — a state entry, a host event or a data source — or two timers share a name (ACT-002).
codes.fix: Name a state entry of the page, the plugin or the app, a host event the app document declares, or a data source in scope; give each timer its own name.

codes.title: Component event not declared
codes.cause: An emitEvent step names an event its component does not declare, or sends a payload to an event that declares none. A component's events are its contract with its users (SCH-030).
codes.fix: Declare the event in the component's events, with the payload type the step sends, or correct its name.

codes.title: emitEvent outside a component
codes.cause: An emitEvent step is in a graph that does not belong to a component: a page's graph or a flow has no component events to emit.
codes.fix: Emit host events with emitHostEvent, or move the step into a handler of the component.

codes.title: Invalid retry policy
codes.cause: A step's retry policy cannot work as written: its maxBackoffMs is below its backoffMs, or it retries cancelled errors, which end the run whatever the step declares (ACT-006).
codes.fix: Set maxBackoffMs to at least backoffMs, and remove cancelled from the error kinds it retries.

codes.title: State entry written that cannot be
codes.cause: A setState, patchState or resetState step names a computed state entry, whose value is derived from other state and recomputed when it changes (STA-004).
codes.fix: Write the entries the computed entry reads, or declare the entry with a default instead of a computed expression.

codes.title: State patch of a value that is not an object
codes.cause: A patchState step names a state entry whose type is not a declared object type, so it has no fields to merge (STA-002).
codes.fix: Use setState to replace the value, or declare the entry with an object type.

codes.title: Persistence that the entry cannot have
codes.cause: A computed state entry, or a run variable (an action graph's state), declares a persistence other than memory: a computed value is derived again from the state it reads, and a run variable ends with its run (STA-001, STA-003).
codes.fix: Remove the persistence, or persist the entries the computed value reads.

codes.title: Stored state changes type without a migration
codes.cause: A session, persisted or secure state entry has another type than in the previous release and declares no migration, so devices could not read the value they stored (STA-040).
codes.fix: Declare a migration on the entry: `from` the previous type with an expression `value` over `previous`, or `reset: true` to start from the default.

codes.title: State migration from a type the previous release did not have
codes.cause: A state entry's migration declares `from` a type other than the entry's type in the previous release, so it would never run on the values devices stored (STA-040).
codes.fix: Set `from` to the entry's type in the previous release, or use `reset: true`.

codes.title: State migration that can never run
codes.cause: A state entry declares a migration although it is computed or kept only in memory, or its migration says `reset: false`, or migrates `from` the type the entry already has (STA-040).
codes.fix: Remove the migration, or give the entry a session, persisted or secure persistence and its previous type in `from`.

codes.title: Invalid data source configuration
codes.cause: The configuration of a REST or GraphQL data source, or of one of its operations, is not what the data layer runs: a property is unknown or missing, the method, path or GraphQL document is malformed, the base URL names no string variable, a cache policy or TTL is invalid, or an operation's input or output type is unknown (DAT-001, DAT-003, DAT-010, ADR-0048).
codes.fix: Correct the configuration as the data sources reference describes; the message names the property.

codes.title: Data source on an undeclared domain
codes.cause: An environment's base URL of a data source is not an HTTPS URL on a domain the plugin declares in capabilities.networkDomains, so every request would be blocked at run time (DAT-030, SEC-080).
codes.fix: Declare the domain in the plugin's capabilities, or correct the environment's base URL.

codes.title: Invalid response mapping
codes.cause: A data source's selector, response type or transform cannot produce its declared type: the selector is malformed, a transform is given without a response type, or the transform's type is not the declared one (DAT-004).
codes.fix: Declare the response type the selector yields and a transform that returns the source's type, or select the declared type directly.

codes.title: Invalid pagination
codes.cause: A paginated data source does not declare a list type, names a style other than cursor, page or offset, lacks the parameter or selector its style needs, or asks for pages larger than the limit data.pageSize (DAT-011).
codes.fix: Declare a list type and the parameters of the style, and keep pageSize within data.pageSize.

codes.title: Credential in a data source header
codes.cause: A data source or operation sets a header that carries credentials (Authorization, Cookie, an API key or token). Secrets never appear in bundles; the auth delegate supplies the user's token and calls needing server-held secrets go through a Plux Function (DAT-003, SEC-107).
codes.fix: Remove the header and set auth to true to send the auth delegate's token, or call the API through a Plux Function.

codes.title: Unknown route
codes.cause: A navigate action targets a route name that no page and no native route declares.
codes.fix: Correct the route name, or add the page.

codes.title: Route parameter missing at navigate
codes.cause: A navigate action does not supply a required parameter of the target page or native route.
codes.fix: Pass the parameter in the action's `params`.

codes.title: Route parameter has the wrong type
codes.cause: A navigate action passes a parameter value whose type differs from the parameter's declared type, or a deep-link pattern reads a parameter whose type a link's text cannot carry (a list, a map or an object).
codes.fix: Pass a value of the declared type; read only scalar and enum parameters from a link's path.

codes.title: Unknown route parameter
codes.cause: A navigate action passes a parameter that the target page or native route does not declare.
codes.fix: Remove the parameter, or declare it on the target.

codes.title: Redirect loop
codes.cause: Pages redirect to each other unconditionally from `onEnter` in a cycle, so navigation would never settle.
codes.fix: Break the cycle by guarding one of the redirects with a condition.

codes.title: Page exceeds its node budget
codes.cause: The page has more nodes than its budget. Above the warning threshold it is reported; above the hard budget publication fails (CMP-040, spec §30.3).
codes.fix: Split the page, move repeated content into a list with an item template, or reuse a component.

codes.title: Page tree too deep
codes.cause: The page's node tree is deeper than its budget (CMP-040).
codes.fix: Flatten redundant wrappers, or extract subtrees into components.

codes.title: Page build cost too high
codes.cause: The page's estimated build cost, the sum of its widgets' cost hints, exceeds its budget (CMP-040).
codes.fix: Replace eagerly built content with lazily built lists, or split the page.

codes.title: Page images too large
codes.cause: The images bundled for the page exceed their byte budget (CMP-040).
codes.fix: Use smaller images or load them from the network.

codes.title: Too many animations
codes.cause: The page can run more concurrent animations than its budget (CMP-040).
codes.fix: Reduce the number of simultaneous animations.

codes.title: Limit exceeded
codes.cause: A document or release exceeds a limit from the limits registry, such as pages per plugin, string prop size or bundle size (spec §30.4).
codes.fix: Reduce the size, or ask an administrator to raise the limit at a higher level.

codes.title: Limit nearly reached
codes.cause: A value has reached its warning threshold, by default 80% of its limit (LIM-003).
codes.fix: Plan to reduce the size before the limit is reached.

codes.title: Interactive node without accessible name
codes.cause: An interactive node has no semantics label and no visible text from which one can be derived, so screen readers cannot announce it (WGT-013, A11Y-002).
codes.fix: Set `semantics.label`, or give the node visible text.

codes.title: Secret-like value detected
codes.cause: A literal looks like an API key, token, private key or password. Bundles are readable on devices, so secrets must never be shipped in them (DAT-003).
codes.fix: Keep the secret on the server and use it through a Plux Function or the host's auth delegate.

codes.title: Sensitive value exposed
codes.cause: A value tagged `sensitive` flows into analytics, logs or another sink where sensitive data is forbidden (SCH-012).
codes.fix: Remove the value from the sink, or pass a non-sensitive derivative such as a masked form.

codes.title: Insecure URL
codes.cause: A literal URL uses `http:`. All network access from Plux uses TLS.
codes.fix: Use an `https:` URL.

codes.title: Executable content not allowed
codes.cause: A document or asset carries code in a form that would run outside the PXL VM and the action interpreter (SEC-054).
codes.fix: Express the logic with actions and PXL, or as a Plux Function.

codes.title: PXL syntax error
codes.cause: The expression does not follow the PXL grammar at the reported position.
codes.fix: Correct the expression; the PXL reference describes the grammar.

codes.title: PXL type mismatch
codes.cause: An operator, function or use site receives a value of a type it does not accept.
codes.fix: Convert the value explicitly, e.g. `double(x)` or `decimal(x)`, or use a matching operator.

codes.title: Unknown identifier
codes.cause: The expression uses a root or variable that is not available at this use site (spec Appendix E.2).
codes.fix: Use a root available here, such as `page`, `params` or `item`, or declare the state entry.

codes.title: Unknown function
codes.cause: The expression calls a function that is not in the PXL standard library.
codes.fix: Correct the function name; the PXL reference lists every function.

codes.title: Wrong number of arguments
codes.cause: A function or macro is called with more or fewer arguments than it takes.
codes.fix: Pass the arguments given by the function's signature.

codes.title: Access on a nullable value
codes.cause: The expression reads a field of, or calls a function on, a value that may be null.
codes.fix: Use null-safe navigation (`a?.b`) or provide a default (`a ?? b`).

codes.title: Decimal division needs a scale and rounding mode
codes.cause: Decimal division can produce infinitely many digits, so PXL requires the scale and rounding mode to be stated (PXL-005).
codes.fix: Write `div(a, b, scale, mode)`, e.g. `div(total, 3d, 2, "halfEven")`.

codes.title: Currency mismatch
codes.cause: Money values in different currencies are added, subtracted or compared.
codes.fix: Convert one amount into the other currency before combining them.

codes.title: Invalid literal
codes.cause: A literal is malformed or out of range, such as an integer beyond 64 bits or an invalid string escape.
codes.fix: Correct the literal.

codes.title: Operation budget exceeded at compile time
codes.cause: Evaluating a constant expression at compile time needed more operations than the budget allows (PXL-001).
codes.fix: Simplify the expression.

codes.title: Constant expression always fails
codes.cause: The expression is constant, and evaluating it at compile time fails, for example by dividing by zero or overflowing.
codes.fix: Correct the expression so it evaluates without error.

codes.title: Unknown field
codes.cause: The expression reads a field that the value's type does not declare.
codes.fix: Correct the field name, or declare the field in the type.

codes.title: Function needs a runtime feature
codes.cause: The expression calls a standard-library function that runtimes evaluate from a later feature, such as locale-aware formatting. The bundle declares the feature, and runtimes without it keep their last compatible release (ADR-0009).
codes.fix: No action is needed if the app's installed runtimes support the feature.

codes.title: Unknown enum member
codes.cause: A string compared with an enum value is not one of the enum's members.
codes.fix: Use one of the members listed in the message.

codes.title: Invalid macro call
codes.cause: A macro such as `map` or `filter` needs a variable name and an expression over it, called on a list, e.g. `items.map(x, x.price)`.
codes.fix: Call the macro on a list with a variable name and an expression.

codes.title: Expression too complex
codes.cause: The expression exceeds the length or nesting depth the compiler accepts.
codes.fix: Split the logic into computed state entries or a Plux Function.

codes.title: Invalid regular expression
codes.cause: A pattern of `matches` is not in the pxl.regex.v1 subset of RE2: for example an unbalanced group, a lookaround, a backreference, a lazy quantifier or an unknown escape (schema/pxl/regex.md).
codes.fix: Correct the pattern at the reported position; the PXL reference lists the supported syntax.

codes.title: Regular expression is not a constant
codes.cause: The pattern of `matches` is computed, so it cannot be compiled and checked at publish time.
codes.fix: Write the pattern as a string literal.

codes.title: Regular expression too large
codes.cause: A pattern of `matches` exceeds the limits pxl.regexPatternLength, pxl.regexProgramSize or pxl.regexRepeat, which keep matching bounded on devices.
codes.fix: Shorten the pattern or reduce its repetition counts; an installation may raise the limits within their maximums.

codes.title: Unknown phone region
codes.cause: The region of `isPhone` is a literal that is not a two-letter region with phone metadata (schema/pxl/phone.md).
codes.fix: Use an ISO 3166 region code such as "GB", or pass the region from state or `device`.

codes.title: Internal compiler error
codes.cause: The compiler met an unexpected condition. This is a bug: the compiler must report problems as diagnostics and never crash (CMP-052).
codes.fix: Report the input to the Plux maintainers.

codes.title: Content identifier collision
codes.cause: Two different PXL programs or style objects received the same 64-bit content identifier (ADR-0002). This is extremely unlikely.
codes.fix: Report the input to the Plux maintainers; changing either value avoids the collision.

codes.title: Manifest signature invalid
codes.cause: The manifest is not signed by a key the app trusts, is not in canonical form, or names another app, environment or channel (SEC-052, ADR-0029).
codes.fix: The device keeps its current release. Check that the app embeds the environment's keys from `plux pull`, and that the server signs with that environment's key.

codes.title: Manifest expired
codes.cause: The manifest's expiry has passed by the device's clock: the server has stopped re-signing it, a network path is replaying an old one, or the device clock is ahead (SEC-052).
codes.fix: The device keeps its current release. Check that the worker role is running and re-signing manifests; check the device clock.

codes.title: Rollback attempt rejected
codes.cause: The manifest's release sequence is lower than one this device has already accepted for the channel (SEC-055). Rollbacks are published as new, higher sequences (REL-006).
codes.fix: The device keeps its current release. Roll back by promoting the earlier content as a new release.

codes.title: Unsupported required feature
codes.cause: The bundle requires a feature that this runtime does not support (BND-008).
codes.fix: Devices keep their last compatible release. Update the app to a runtime with the feature, or avoid the feature in the release.

codes.title: Hash mismatch after patch
codes.cause: A section or bundle rebuilt from a delta does not have the hash the delta and the manifest name: the delta was made against another base, or it is corrupt (ADR-0003, SYN-011).
codes.fix: Download the full bundle instead of the delta.

codes.title: Malformed delta
codes.cause: The delta's header or instructions are invalid: wrong magic or version, a truncated instruction, an unknown operation or a size beyond the limits (ADR-0003).
codes.fix: Download the full bundle instead of the delta.

codes.title: Reverted to last known good release
codes.cause: A newly activated release caused three or more fatal errors or crashes within its first two launches, so the device went back to the previous release and pinned it until a newer sequence arrives (SYN-006).
codes.fix: Inspect the release's error reports, fix the cause and publish a new release; devices move on automatically.

codes.title: Disk quota exceeded
codes.cause: Staging the release would exceed the device's disk quota for Plux (`device.diskQuota`), or the device ran out of storage while writing it. The active release is untouched (SYN-012).
codes.fix: Reduce the release's size, raise the quota in the app's limits, or free storage on the device.

codes.title: Malformed bundle
codes.cause: The container header or section directory is invalid: wrong magic or version, unknown flags, overlapping or misaligned sections, a size mismatch or a header hash mismatch (BND-003).
codes.fix: Rebuild the bundle. A malformed bundle is never loaded.

codes.title: Section hash mismatch
codes.cause: A section's SHA-256 differs from the hash in the directory: the bundle is corrupt or has been tampered with (BND-005).
codes.fix: Download or rebuild the bundle.

codes.title: Section failed verification
codes.cause: A section is not a well-formed FlatBuffers buffer of its kind, or exceeds the verifier's limits (BND-006).
codes.fix: Rebuild the bundle; a section that fails verification is never read.

codes.title: Encrypted bundle not supported
codes.cause: The bundle is marked as encrypted, which this reader does not support (SEC-053).
codes.fix: Use a reader that supports confidential bundles.

codes.title: Transport decoding failed
codes.cause: The zstd transport encoding is corrupt, or it decompresses to more than the declared size or the configured limit (BND-007).
codes.fix: Download the bundle again.

codes.title: Asset file hash mismatch
codes.cause: An asset file's SHA-256 differs from the hash its signed bundle lists: the download is corrupt or has been tampered with (AST-001).
codes.fix: Nothing to change in the app: the runtime discards the file and keeps the active release; sync again, and check the CDN or proxy if it persists.

codes.title: Sync failed
codes.cause: The runtime could not complete a sync: the server was unreachable or answered with an error, a download failed after its retries, or a bundle failed verification after the full-bundle retry (SYN-010, SYN-011). The cause is in the error's details.
codes.fix: The device keeps its current release and retries at the next start or manual sync. Check the server's health and the device's connectivity.

codes.title: Build error in node
codes.cause: Building, laying out or painting a node failed, or a value it needs could not be decoded or evaluated. The page's error boundary rendered its fallback (RT-020). A PluxView that expands in unbounded constraints shows its fallback with it too (NAV-004).
codes.fix: Look up the node path in the report and fix the page; the source map of a development bundle names the document location.

codes.title: Prop value not usable
codes.cause: A prop's value could not be decoded as its type, or its binding failed to evaluate. The prop took its declared default and the node rendered (ADR-0031).
codes.fix: Look up the node path in the report and fix the value or the expression; the source map of a development bundle names the document location.

codes.title: Unknown widget type
codes.cause: A node names a widget type this runtime does not know. A neutral placeholder is shown instead (WGT-014).
codes.fix: Raise the app's minimum runtime version for the widget, or update the host app to a newer runtime.

codes.title: Actions not available in this runtime
codes.cause: A step names an action, or a graph declares an option (a concurrency policy other than drop, a retry, a detached run), that this runtime does not run; the step fails with this error, which its onError can handle, and the option is ignored (ADR-0039). An exposed app state entry that declares a persistence is kept in memory until P5, and reported with it once in debug builds (ADR-0023).
codes.fix: Raise the app's minimum runtime version to one that runs the action, or handle the error; the action reference page says which phase delivers each action.

codes.title: Plugin switched off
codes.cause: The release's control switches turn the plugin off (kill switch), so every route into it shows its fallback page (RT-022).
codes.fix: Turn the switch off in the release's channel controls once the problem is fixed.

codes.title: Route not found
codes.cause: A navigation, a deep link or a PluxView names a route that is neither a page of the active release nor a registered native route, and for a PluxView no exported component has that key either. The app's not-found page is shown instead (NAV-011).
codes.fix: Check the route name, publish the page that should answer it, or register the native route in PluxConfig.

codes.title: Invalid route parameters
codes.cause: A route was entered with a parameter missing, unknown or of the wrong type for the page's declaration. The page's error fallback is shown instead of the page (NAV-007).
codes.fix: Pass every required parameter with the declared type; a deep link's or push payload's values must convert to the parameter types.

codes.title: Navigation refused
codes.cause: A route guard refused entry, because its graph decided on the fallback or failed and the guard failed closed (NAV-009); or the navigation needs what the screen does not have, such as a switchTab with no enclosing shell holding the tab, or a pop with nothing to pop (NAV-005).
codes.fix: If the refusal is unexpected, check the guard's condition and the state it reads, such as the auth delegate, flags or the device's assurance level, or where the page is shown.

codes.title: Deep link not mapped
codes.cause: A deep link or push payload names a host, scheme or path that the app's navigation.deepLinks do not map to a route, so nothing was opened (NAV-008).
codes.fix: Add a path pattern for the link to navigation.deepLinks, or link to https://<host>/p/<route-name>, which always resolves.

codes.title: Native route not registered
codes.cause: A plugin navigated to a native route that the host app did not register in PluxConfig or expose through its router (NAV-002, HST-031).
codes.fix: Register the route in the host app, or run plux native scan and sync so publishing checks the route against the host build (WGT-032).

codes.title: Native slot not registered
codes.cause: A page places a native slot widget that the host app did not register in PluxConfig.nativeSlots. The page's error boundary shows a placeholder instead (WGT-033).
codes.fix: Register the slot's builder in the host app, or run plux native scan and sync so publishing checks the slot against the host build (WGT-032).

codes.title: Custom action not registered
codes.cause: A callNative step names a custom action that the host app did not register in PluxConfig.nativeActions; the step fails and its onError handler runs (ACT-060).
codes.fix: Register the action in the host app, or run plux native scan and sync so publishing checks the action against the host build (WGT-032).

codes.title: Exposed state written with the wrong type
codes.cause: Native code wrote a value to an exposed state entry whose declared type the value does not have, read, wrote or watched a name the app does not expose, or wrote before a release was active; the write is refused and the entry keeps its value (STA-030, HST-021).
codes.fix: Write a value of the entry's declared type; plux codegen generates typed accessors that make this a compile error.

codes.title: User context attribute ignored
codes.cause: Plux.setUserContext was given an attribute the app's userContext does not declare, or one whose text does not convert to its declared type; the attribute is left out of user.<name>, which reads as null (HST-011).
codes.fix: Pass only the attributes the app declares, each as the text of its declared type: true or false, a number, a decimal, an ISO 8601 date, or an enum member.

codes.title: Host code failed
codes.cause: A custom action's handler, a native route's parameter conversion or screen, or a native slot's builder registered by the host app threw; the step fails, or the page shows its error fallback, and nothing reaches the plugin as a crash (ACT-060, NAV-002, WGT-033).
codes.fix: Fix the host's handler, conversion or builder; the report names the action, route or slot and only the exception's type, never its message.

codes.title: Action timed out
codes.cause: A step or its run took longer than the limits action.stepTimeout or action.runTimeout, or the step's own timeoutMs, allow; time spent waiting for the user in a dialog or bottom sheet does not count (ACT-005, ADR-0039).
codes.fix: Handle the error with the step's onError, or make the work shorter; an installation may raise the limits within their maximums.

codes.title: Step limit exceeded
codes.cause: A run executed more steps than the limit action.stepsPerRun allows, and was stopped (ACT-005, ADR-0039).
codes.fix: Shorten the graph, or move repeated work into a flow.

codes.title: Action value of the wrong type
codes.cause: A step's input, output or result does not have the type its action, page or graph declares, or a binding of an input could not be evaluated; the step fails with a validation error (ADR-0039).
codes.fix: Check the bindings of the step's inputs and the values the host passes or returns.

codes.title: Run failed with a custom error
codes.cause: A stop step ended the run with a custom error code, and no onError handled it (ADR-0039).
codes.fix: Handle the error with an onError edge, or check why the graph stops with it; the message carries its code.

codes.title: Action run cancelled
codes.cause: A run, or a branch of a parallel step, was cancelled: its page or component was disposed, a restart policy started a newer run, or another branch of the parallel step failed (ACT-003, ACT-004). Cancellation ends the run; it is never routed to an error handler.
codes.fix: Nothing to fix when the owner went away. Mark the handler detached when its run must outlive its page.

codes.title: forEach item limit exceeded
codes.cause: A forEach step was given more items than the limit action.forEachItems allows; the step fails before its body runs (ACT-005).
codes.fix: Iterate over fewer items, for example a page of them, or raise the limit within its maximum.

codes.title: Flow not found
codes.cause: A callFlow step names a flow the active release does not hold, or a flow of another plugin that is not exported in that plugin's active version (ACT-061).
codes.fix: Publish the plugin that declares the flow, export it, or handle the error with the step's onError.

codes.title: Error handler failed
codes.cause: A page, plugin or app error handler failed while handling a run's error; its failure is reported and the original error goes on to the next handler (ACT-020).
codes.fix: Fix the error handler's graph; the report names the handler's owner and its own error code.

codes.title: Action queue full
codes.cause: A handler with the queue policy was triggered while it already held as many waiting triggers as the limit action.queueLength allows; the trigger was dropped (ACT-003).
codes.fix: Use the drop, restart or debounce policy for triggers that come faster than their runs finish, or raise the limit within its maximum.

codes.title: Request to an undeclared domain blocked
codes.cause: A data source or operation was about to send a request to a host the plugin does not declare in capabilities.networkDomains, or over a scheme other than HTTPS. The request never left the device, and the attempt is reported (DAT-030, SEC-080).
codes.fix: Declare the domain in the plugin's capabilities, or correct the base URL of the environment.

codes.title: Network request failed
codes.cause: A data request could not be completed: the device is offline, the connection failed or was reset. The step's error has the kind network (DAT-001).
codes.fix: Handle the error with onError, show the source's error state, or retry when the network returns.

codes.title: Request answered with an error status
codes.cause: The server answered a data request with a status outside 2xx. The step's error has the kind http and carries the status, never the response body (DAT-001, SCH-012).
codes.fix: Handle the error with onError; check the request against the API.

codes.title: Data request timed out
codes.cause: A data request took longer than the limit data.requestTimeout. The step's error has the kind timeout (DAT-001).
codes.fix: Handle the error with onError, or ask the API owner why it is slow; an installation may raise the limit within its maximum.

codes.title: Response does not match its declared type
codes.cause: A response is not JSON, its selector finds nothing, a value does not have the type the source or operation declares, or the transform failed. The step's error has the kind validation and names the path, never the value (DAT-004).
codes.fix: Correct the selector, the declared types or the transform, or ask the API owner about the response.

codes.title: Request or response too large
codes.cause: A data request's body is larger than data.requestSize, or its response larger than data.responseSize; the transfer is stopped (LIM-004).
codes.fix: Request less data, for example with pagination, or raise the limit within its maximum.

codes.title: GraphQL request failed
codes.cause: A GraphQL response carried errors and no data. The step's error has the kind http; the GraphQL messages are not reported, since they may echo user data (DAT-001, SCH-012).
codes.fix: Check the GraphQL document and its variables against the schema.

codes.title: Request unauthorised
codes.cause: A data request that sends the auth delegate's token was answered with 401 again after one refresh, or no token was available. The step's error has the kind http (HST-010).
codes.fix: Sign the user in again through the host app; check the auth delegate's refresh.

codes.title: Data source unavailable
codes.cause: A step or binding names a data source or operation this release does not declare, the source has no base URL for the current environment, or its kind is one this runtime does not load yet (DAT-001, DAT-003).
codes.fix: Declare the source and a base URL for every environment, or raise the app's minimum runtime version to one that loads its kind.

codes.title: Response cache unavailable
codes.cause: The response cache could not be read or written, or its encryption key could not be obtained; the request goes to the network as with networkOnly, and nothing is stored in the clear (DAT-010, LIM-004).
codes.fix: Check the device's free storage and the key provider; the runtime keeps working without the cache.

codes.title: State written with a value of the wrong type
codes.cause: A state write received a value from outside the bundle (an API response, a custom action, the host) that does not have the entry's declared type; the step fails with a validation error and the entry keeps its value (STA-002).
codes.fix: Map the value to the declared type before writing it, or handle the step's error with onError.

codes.title: State write refused
codes.cause: A state write names a path its scope does not have or a computed entry, or patches an entry that is not an object; the step fails and nothing changes (STA-001, STA-004).
codes.fix: Check the path against the entries the page, component, plugin, app or run declares; the compiler reports this for literal paths (PLX-1140, PLX-1141).

codes.title: State store unavailable
codes.cause: The runtime could not open or write its local state store, or could not obtain the store's key from the platform's secure storage; session, persisted and secure entries are kept in memory until the store works again (STA-003).
codes.fix: Check the device's free space and the platform's secure storage; the message names the failing operation, never a value.

codes.title: State store failed authentication
codes.cause: The local state store did not decrypt under its key: it was altered, truncated or written by another installation. It is discarded, and every stored entry starts from its default (STA-003).
codes.fix: Nothing to fix in the app; if it repeats, check the device for tampering with the app's storage.

codes.title: Stored state could not be migrated
codes.cause: A stored value had neither the entry's type nor the type its migration reads, or the migration failed; the entry starts from its default (STA-040).
codes.fix: Declare a migration from the previous type, and check that it handles every stored value.

codes.title: Stored state over its limit
codes.cause: The values to store exceed state.persistedBytes or state.secureBytes; the write takes effect in memory but is not stored, so it is lost when the app is closed (LIM-001, LIM-004).
codes.fix: Store less, for example by keeping large data in a local collection, or raise the limit for the app.

codes.title: Host event refused
codes.cause: Plux.sendEvent named an event the app does not declare for the host to send (direction toPlux or both), or a payload without the event's fields and types; nothing runs (HST-013).
codes.fix: Declare the event in the app's hostEvents with the direction toPlux or both; plux codegen generates typed senders that make this a compile error.

codes.title: Outbound request blocked
codes.cause: A request to a user-supplied URL would have reached a private, loopback, link-local or metadata address. Those are refused unless the installation allows them explicitly (SEC-105).
codes.fix: Use a publicly reachable address, or ask an administrator to allow the range this installation should reach.

codes.title: Asset rejected by the malware scanner
codes.cause: The installation's malware scanner found something in the uploaded file (SRV-060).
codes.fix: Check the file on a trusted machine and upload a clean copy.

codes.title: Second factor required
codes.cause: The capability this call needs — publishing, approving, managing keys or managing members — requires a second factor, and the session has not completed one (SEC-100).
codes.fix: Complete the second factor and repeat the call.

codes.title: Authentication required
codes.cause: The call carried no credential, or one that has expired or been revoked.
codes.fix: Sign in again, or use a valid access token.

codes.title: Editing lock held by another user
codes.cause: Editing a plugin requires holding its lock, and someone else holds it. The lock expires two minutes after the holder's last heartbeat (SRV-040).
codes.fix: Ask the holder for the lock, wait for it to expire, or take it over if you may (SRV-041).

codes.title: Permission denied
codes.cause: The caller does not hold the permission this call needs on this resource. Authorisation is deny-by-default (SEC-102).
codes.fix: Ask an administrator of the organisation for the permission the message names.

codes.title: Not found
codes.cause: The resource does not exist, or the caller may not see it. The two are reported the same way, so that the API does not disclose what exists in another organisation.
codes.fix: Check the identifier, and that you have access to the organisation that owns it.

codes.title: Already exists
codes.cause: Something with this key already exists where keys must be unique, such as an organisation, team, app, environment or channel key.
codes.fix: Choose another key, or use the existing resource.

codes.title: Precondition failed
codes.cause: The call is valid but the resource is not in a state that allows it, such as removing an organisation's last owner or accepting an invitation that has expired.
codes.fix: Read the message for the state that blocks the call, change it, and repeat the call.

codes.title: Rate limit exceeded
codes.cause: The caller has made more requests than the limit for this principal, device or address allows (SRV-065).
codes.fix: Retry after the interval the response reports.

codes.title: Versions compiled against different sources
codes.cause: A plugin version in the release was compiled against app-level documents or assets other than the release's, so its bundle would differ if it were compiled with them (REL-003).
codes.fix: Publish the plugin again against the current app version, then create the release.

codes.title: Warnings not acknowledged
codes.cause: The publish found warnings, and the publisher did not acknowledge them (SRV-051).
codes.fix: Fix the warnings, or publish again acknowledging them.

codes.title: Plugin has no published version
codes.cause: An app release holds exactly one version of every active plugin and one app bundle, and this one has none (REL-002).
codes.fix: Publish the plugin, or delete it, before creating the release.

codes.title: Assets still being processed
codes.cause: A publish waits until every image asset of the app has its variants (CMP-030), since a bundle compiled without them would differ from the release's (REL-003). Some were still being processed when the wait, publish.assetWait, ran out: the worker's asset jobs are slow, failing or not running.
codes.fix: Check the assets' processing state, and the worker's asset jobs if an asset stays pending; publish again once every asset is ready.

codes.title: Host build lacks a native entry
codes.cause: The release uses a native route, native slot or custom action that the native catalogue of one of the app's host builds lacks, or declares with other parameters, props, events, inputs or result types. Devices of that build keep receiving the newest release compatible with it (WGT-032, REL-080).
codes.fix: Ship a host build that registers the entry and upload its catalogue with plux native sync, or keep the release from using the entry; the publisher acknowledges the warning to publish anyway.

codes.title: Internal error
codes.cause: The server failed in a way it does not recognise. The incident identifier in the message appears in the server's logs; nothing else about the failure is returned.
codes.fix: Retry the call. If it keeps failing, give the incident identifier to the operator of the installation.

codes.title: A service the server depends on is unavailable
codes.cause: The server could not reach a service outside it that the call needs, such as the single sign-on provider.
codes.fix: Retry later. If it persists, the operator checks the service and the server's outbound network.

codes.title: Invalid CLI configuration
codes.cause: A command-line argument, flag or configuration value is invalid.
codes.fix: Run the command with `--help` to see the accepted arguments.

codes.title: Project not found
codes.cause: The directory does not contain a Plux project: `app.json` is missing (SCH-006).
codes.fix: Run the command in a project directory, or pass the project's path.

codes.title: File system error
codes.cause: A file or directory could not be read or written.
codes.fix: Check that the path exists and is accessible.
